replies.author: swivr
replies.body:
No.... It's a feature that 1.7 brought into Minecraft. Was it copying when a server first started using blocks in inventories as buttons and other servers trailed behind? No, because it's a feature that Minecraft brought in. It's just a matter of time before servers start using features that are useful in making the user experience better. Now it seems every server uses the holograms, and it's most likely that many of those server owners have never heard of OCN.

Edit: On topic, we may be removing the holograms and using an item in the inventory to select your game. The "click towards the general location of a game to be teleported there" feature was not well known and it takes quite a bit of computing I believe, in effect slowing down the hub servers. Could do some testing on that.

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
To be perfectly honest, I think these holograms are okay the way that they already are. They really do not make too much of a problem for many people, and they are quite efficient for travelling around the server.
However.... I think the compass should be added back because if you use the holograms to teleport to Control The Hill (As an example), and once you do, you realize that you actually want to play Nexus, you have to work your way back to the holograms or to the actual Nexus server selection place.
The compass will allow to you quick travel to the gamemode of your choice.
Just my opinion.
